item.text:
Bob, these expense claims are waiting for your approval:

- EXP-7 — Alice Example: £84 taxi to customer site in Leeds (14 Oct); receipt attached.
- EXP-8 — Dave Example: £230 LeedsJS 2026 conference ticket; receipt attached.
- EXP-9 — Dave Example: £4,800 consulting services from Northwind Advisory Ltd, invoice NW-2207; no receipt attached.

Unusual: EXP-9 is high-value, lacks a receipt, and includes an urgency request to approve before 31 October. It cites Finance pre-approval (FIN-22) and says Finance holds the receipt, so you may want to verify that reference before approving.
